title: helichrysum gunnii subsp. paralium
intro: Helichrysum gunnii subsp. paralium, commonly known as the Dwarf Curry Plant, is a perennial herb in the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in wound healing, skin care, and immune system support. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum gunnii subsp. paralium include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote tissue repair, and exhibit sedative and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
